test_scf_interface: test the Scf class interface with parameterized molecules and electron configurations
run_scf_calculation: run a restricted or unrestricted Hartree-Fock SCF calculation on a molecule
create_scf_object: create an Scf object with a molecule, electron count, and restricted flag
eval_mos: evaluate molecular orbital values at random 3D coordinate points
test_scf_diatomics: test SCF calculations on simple diatomic molecules like N2 and O2
